title: Conductor radical contains u times every coefficient
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $x\in S$; let $\varphi:R[X]\to S$ be the homomorphism of $R$-algebras from the polynomial ring [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $X\mapsto x$, so that $\varphi(R[X])=R[x]$ is the $R$-subalgebra of $S$ generated by $x$. Assume (a) $S$ is a finitely generated $R[X]$-module via $\varphi$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and (b) $R$ is integrally closed in $S$ in the sense that every element of $S$ integral over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] lies in the image of $R\to S$. Let $J=\{g\in S\mid gS\subseteq\varphi(R[X])\}$ (the conductor, an ideal of $S$) and $\sqrt J=\{s\in S\mid s^m\in J\text{ for some }m\ge1\}$ its radical. If $u\in S$ and $a_0,\dots,a_k\in R$ satisfy $u\,\varphi(a_0+a_1X+\dots+a_kX^k)\in\sqrt J$, then $u\,\varphi(a_i)\in\sqrt J$ for every $i=0,\dots,k$.
